user.title: Feuerwehr OÖ Einsätze
user.description: Shows the incidents currently running in Upper Austria, from the public feed of the Oö. Landes-Feuerwehrverband. More filters are available later under *Configure*.

data_description.name: Name of this feed. Create several to watch different districts.
data_description.districts: Only show incidents in these districts. Leave empty for all of Upper Austria.
data_description.include_self_initiated: Brigades that roll out on their own or exercises (type SELBST) make up most of the list. They are hidden by default.

error.cannot_connect: The incident feed could not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_data: The incident feed returned data in an unexpected format.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: A feed with this name is already set up.

init.title: Filters
init.description: An incident is shown when it passes all filters that are set.

data_description.districts: Only show incidents in these districts. Leave empty for all of Upper Austria.
data_description.keywords: Only show incidents whose type, subtype or place contains one of these words (for example Brand, Verkehr, Wald).
data_description.include_self_initiated: Brigades that roll out on their own or exercises (type SELBST) make up most of the list.
data_description.min_alarm_level: Hide incidents below this alarm level. 0 shows all.
data_description.max_incidents: How many of the newest incidents are listed in the attributes and get a map entity.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two reads of the feed.

cannot_connect.message: Could not read the incident feed: {error}

invalid_data.message: The incident feed has an unexpected format: {error}
